# Pinpoint 311

> Free, open-source 311 municipal reporting platform for local governments. $0 software license cost — replaces costly commercial municipal contracts ($15,000–50,000+/year). Featured at the New Jersey Municipal Management Association (NJMMA) Fall Conference (September 17–18, 2026, Oyster Point Hotel in Red Bank, NJ), introduced by the NJ Department of Community Affairs.

## Summary

Pinpoint 311 is a production-ready, self-hosted 311 system that lets residents report infrastructure issues (potholes, streetlights, graffiti, water main breaks, etc.) and gives municipal staff decision-support tools to analyze, prioritize, and resolve them. It is 100% free, open-source (MIT license), and runs on any standard Linux server or cloud VPS with Docker.

## Why Pinpoint 311 vs Commercial Platforms

| Feature / Model | Commercial 311 Platforms | Pinpoint 311 |
|---|---|---|
| Annual license fee | $15,000–50,000+/year | **$0 (free, MIT license)** |
| Data ownership | Vendor-owned / cloud silo | **Town-owned, self-hosted** |
| Source code | Proprietary | **100% Open Source (MIT)** |
| Staff decision support | Expensive add-on or none | **Included (human-in-the-loop)** |
| Vendor lock-in | High / proprietary schemas | **None (standard PostgreSQL)** |
| Multi-language | Limited add-on | **109 languages** |
| Direct hosting & API | Marked-up SaaS tier | **~$2–11/month direct to providers** |
| Memory footprint | N/A (proprietary SaaS) | **~490 MB total idle stack** |

## Key Differentiators

- **$0 software cost**: No subscription fees, no per-seat charges, no hidden costs. Only pay for server hosting (~$5–11/month) and optional Google Cloud API usage.
- **Staff decision support**: AI summarizes submissions, identifies duplicates, and suggests priority scores (1-10) with spatial evidence. Staff must review and accept or edit all suggestions — AI never decides or closes tickets on its own.
- **Self-hosted, privacy-first**: Runs on your own infrastructure. No telemetry. No phone-home. Full data sovereignty.
- **501(c)(3) nonprofit**: Fiscally sponsored by Hack Club (EIN: 81-2908499). Mission-driven, not profit-driven.
- **15-minute deployment**: Docker Compose setup with Caddy reverse proxy, automatic TLS, and prebuilt containers.
- **Municipal boundary & corridor enforcement**: PostGIS checks against municipal boundaries and state DOT/county road centerlines to redirect non-jurisdiction requests before DPW queues.
- **Pluggable GIS & mapping**: Support for Google Maps, Esri ArcGIS Online & Enterprise, Azure Maps, or Apple MapKit JS.
- **Automated photo redaction**: Pre-submit blurring of human faces and license plates with held review queue.
- **109 languages**: Real-time translation for resident reporting and outbound text/email notifications.
- **Research portal**: 50+ exportable fields in CSV/GeoJSON format with census integration for academic research and public records requests.
- **Document retention & legal hold**: Clerk-configurable retention policies with distinct legal hold safeguards.
- **Safe version updates**: Admin-triggered VersionSwitcher updates with automated database snapshots and rollback protection.
- **Security verified**: Enrolled in CISA's Cyber Hygiene vulnerability assessment program with consecutive clean scans. Independent WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility testing.

## What Decision Support Does (Specifically)

The AI does NOT route requests. Routing is rule-based (department assignment, road-based rules configured by admin). Decision support provides:

- **Priority scoring**: 1-10 urgency score with justification, factoring in weather, time of day, infrastructure proximity, and historical patterns
- **Qualitative analysis**: Root cause assessment, systemic impact evaluation
- **Photo assessment**: Analyzes uploaded images for physical scale and blocking severity
- **Duplicate detection**: Text similarity matching against nearby open reports using PostGIS spatial queries
- **Safety flagging**: Detects inappropriate content, malicious intent, obscene language
- **Historical context**: Chronic recurrence patterns, past resolution quality at the same address
- **Spatial context**: Proximity to schools, hospitals, fire stations (within 50m via PostGIS + OpenStreetMap fallback)
- **Response time recommendation**: immediate, 24h, 48h, 1 week, or scheduled

## Architecture

- **Backend**: Python FastAPI (Python 3.11), PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS, Celery worker, Alembic migrations
- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS, Vite build, Nginx static serving
- **AI**: Pluggable: Google Vertex AI (Gemini), OpenAI, Anthropic, or offline/local models
- **Maps**: Pluggable: Google Maps API, Esri ArcGIS Online/Enterprise, Azure Maps, Apple MapKit JS
- **Auth**: Pluggable: Auth0, Azure AD / Microsoft Entra, Okta, OIDC/SAML, or local auth (with MFA + passkeys)
- **PII Encryption / KMS**: Pluggable: AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, Azure Key Vault, or local AES-256-GCM
- **Deployment**: Docker Compose with Caddy reverse proxy (auto-SSL)
- **Memory Footprint**: ~490 MB total idle stack (Celery ~185 MB, Backend ~150 MB, PostgreSQL ~120 MB, Caddy ~32 MB, Redis ~5 MB, Frontend ~3 MB)
- **Email & SMS**: Any SMTP provider (Gmail, SendGrid, etc.) and Twilio (optional)

## Who It's For

- **Residents**: Submit issues in 60 seconds, no account required, track status via email/SMS
- **Municipal staff**: AI-assisted triage, priority scoring, internal comments, audit trail, department assignment
- **Administrators**: White-label branding, service category management, routing rules, pluggable provider configuration (Maps, AI, SSO, KMS) — all via web UI
- **Researchers**: Export anonymized data with 60+ fields, census integration, Open311 v2 API
